intermediate.name: Muro di Ca' del Poggio
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (4) Muro di Ca' del Poggio (44.7 km)
Red Bull KM Sprint | Enego (185.8 km)

story: From the start, there was an intense fight for the breakaway. A large group eventually went clear after the Muro di Ca’ del Poggio. On Monte Grappa, the leading group split into several smaller groups. Between Monte Grappa and the final climb, a chasing group including Verona bridged across from the peloton to the front. With 44 kilometres to go, Verona attacked and went solo. Meanwhile, the pace increased in the GC group, with Primož Roglič unable to follow. Verona held his advantage to take victory.
